xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4650: Conversations across machines: shared list, remote control, Pull here, machine-aware UI

plan.title: Conversations across machines: shared list, remote control, Pull here, machine-aware UI
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator decomposed epic PAN-2350 into sibling issues and assigned W-CONV2, W-CONV3, W-CONV4, W-CONV5, W-CONV7, W-CONV8 and W-CONV9 to this issue as one unit; they share the linked-conversation cache, the proxy prefix and the title-bar states, so the 23 items here are already the vertical slices of that unit.

narratives.Problem: PAN-4645 links two machines' dashboards over an encrypted channel, but nothing uses the link for conversations: the laptop cannot list, open, control, message or take over a conversation that runs on the desktop, cannot preview its dev server, and cannot open its checkout.
narratives.Proposal: Add a linked_conversations cache synced from each owner on connect and on heartbeat hash change, merged into GET /api/conversations with one row per native session; remote control through a /api/conversations/@<machine>/* proxy and /ws/linked/<env>/rpc|terminal byte pipes; Pull here as owner release (409 conversation-released afterwards) plus a transfer-vault adopt through the existing Continue here code, with undo on failure and a vault fallback when offline; the approved machine-aware UI (five title-bar states, chips, banner, Hide this machine, Pull dialog, Preview, remote editor picker); pan tell @<label>/<conv>; owner /ws/forward with the D-22 denylist and viewer forwards on 127.0.0.1; remote-SSH Open in editor. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-4650.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Starting conversations, workers or lanes on another machine, --machine, delegation, and widening the agent fence for link-started conversations (#4651)
- The project-header 'origin · N machines' line (FR-12, #4651)
- ssh route kind and SSH machines (#4404); directory, direct and relay routes (#2356); Tailscale setup (#1254)
- Running one conversation on two machines at once, or any timer-based automatic undo of a release
- Marking released_to on an old owner after an offline vault Continue here (existing vault continuity badge covers it)
- A per-conversation privacy flag
- Streaming a remote simulator or browser view; previews through anything but a TCP port forward
- Cursor and Windsurf remote-SSH launches
- Linked rows in `pan conv list`
- Raising any file-size allowlist cap

autoDecisions.summary: Keep all seven work items (W-CONV2/3/4/5/7/8/9) in this one issue and set sizeJustification instead of filing new sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator already decomposed the PAN-2350 epic into sibling issues and assigned exactly these items to PAN-4650; re-splitting would contradict the issue's stated scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Remote control over HTTP is a path-prefix proxy (/api/conversations/@<machine>/<name>/*) and over WebSocket a raw byte pipe (/ws/linked/<env>/rpc|terminal).
autoDecisions.rationale: Existing frontend call sites keep building /api/conversations/${name}/… unchanged, and the owner's PAN-4645 scope tables stay the single authority; a byte pipe avoids re-serializing Effect RPC.

autoDecisions.summary: Change detection is a conversations hash in the heartbeat, with a full shared-list refetch only when it changes.
autoDecisions.rationale: Satisfies NFR-5 (no list polling) without a delta protocol; trimmed rows keep a full refetch near 150 KB for 500 conversations.

autoDecisions.summary: Online pulls move the conversation through a one-time transfer vault store inside the secure channel and adopt with the existing continueHere code.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses settle, WIP capture, adopt, materialize and resume as shipped and tested; FR-8 requires no vault backend when both machines are online.

autoDecisions.summary: No automatic undo of a release; recovery is `pan conv reclaim` with a liveness check on the target.
autoDecisions.rationale: NFR-4 (one runner) outranks availability: an automatic undo after a lost 'complete' call could start a second runner.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent actors on a link are refused all conversation writes, terminal and forward on the owner (403 agent-fenced) in this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-4 limits agents to conversations the link started, and no conversation is link-started until #4651; reads stay allowed.

autoDecisions.summary: Senders the local prompt guard treats as operator (no OVERDECK_AGENT_ID, conv-operator-<pid>, operator conversations) map to the operator actor for pan tell @.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-28 asks the owner to apply the same role and id checks as a local pan tell, so the existing isOperatorConversation rule is reused unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: The sharing switch lives in ${OVERDECK_HOME}/anywhere.json and Hide this machine is a hidden flag on the link record.
autoDecisions.rationale: The Settings whole-document save is lossy (concerns.md), and hiding is a per-link property next to the rest of the link.

autoDecisions.summary: Remote editor supports VS Code, VS Code Insiders and VSCodium only; Cursor and Windsurf are shown disabled with a tooltip.
autoDecisions.rationale: The FR-30 checkpoint could not be verified: Windsurf's --help lists no --remote flag and Cursor's CLI launches its GUI; the PRD's own fallback and the approved mockup both disable them.

autoDecisions.summary: Mockup open questions 2-6 take the mockup's choices: saved copy on demand, Pull here hidden while offline (banner Continue here instead), narrow-width fold into the ⋮ menu, Hide this machine in the row menu with a Show footer, Stop it now neutral.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator approved the mockup as built; only question 1 (the --surface-remote recipe) was answered explicitly, and it was answered in the mockup's favor.

autoDecisions.summary: Linked rows are included in GET /api/conversations by default; ?linked=0 opts out and the status bar and God View use it.
autoDecisions.rationale: W-CONV2's done-when says the list includes the desktop's rows; the two consumers that count this machine's runtime must not count another machine's.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-10 and D-4650-12/13/14. startPull({conversation: '@env/name', whenTurnRunning}) job in memory (1 h): step release (linkForward POST release, 31-minute timeout), step transfer (GET pack, unpack into ${OVERDECK_HOME}/pull-transfers/<transferId>/store), step adopt (archive a local row whose native session id matches and whose released_to is set; then continueHere(vaultId, {expectedOwnerToken: ownerToken(ownerEnvironmentId), onDrift: 'note'}, {openVaultContext: async () => ({status: 'open', vault: {config, keys: deriveSubkeys(key), store: await storeForBackend('dir:<path>'), rotatedAt: null}}), removeVaultBrowseRow: async () => {}})), step finish (POST release/complete). Adopt failure -> POST release/undo and job failed. Owner link not online -> previewContinue + continueHere on the row's savedCopyName vault id; no saved copy -> failed 'owner-offline-no-saved-copy'. Routes POST /api/linked-conversations/pull (202 {pullId}) and GET /api/linked-conversations/pull/:pullId ({step, state, error?, conversation?}); admin by default; no-loss rows. Never delete a transcript file.
